mapper.sql: FROM price_version v JOIN price_record r ON r.id=v.record_id JOIN price_part p ON p.id=r.part_id JOIN price_model m ON m.id=r.model_id JOIN price_brand b ON b.id=m.brand_id LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.id=r.region_id LEFT JOIN repair_shop sh ON sh.id=r.shop_id

v.*,r.part_id,p.internal_code,p.name AS part_name,r.model_id,m.name AS model_name, m.brand_id,b.name AS brand_name,r.price_type,r.scope,r.region_id,rg.name AS region_name,r.shop_id,sh.name AS shop_name

where.if: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM price_alias a WHERE a.part_id=p.id AND a.name=#{f.alias})
AND (r.scope='NATIONAL' OR r.scope='REGION' AND r.region_id=#{f.regionId} OR r.scope='SHOP' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_service_region s WHERE s.shop_id=r.shop_id AND s.region_id=#{f.regionId}))
AND (r.scope='NATIONAL' OR r.scope='SHOP' AND r.shop_id=#{f.shopId} OR r.scope='REGION' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shop_service_region s WHERE s.shop_id=#{f.shopId} AND s.region_id=r.region_id))

mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM price_version WHERE record_id=#{id}
SELECT WHERE r.id=#{id} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(k) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT hashtextextended(value,0) AS k FROM (VALUES (#{key})) q(value) ORDER BY k) locked
mapper.sql: SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{rows} AS jsonb)) AS d("rowNumber" integer,"partId" bigint,"modelId" bigint, "priceType" varchar,"scope" varchar,"regionId" bigint,"shopId" bigint,"amount" numeric,"sourceId" bigint,"effectiveFrom" date,"effectiveTo" date)
r.part_id=d."partId" AND r.model_id=d."modelId" AND r.price_type=d."priceType" AND r.scope=d."scope" AND r.region_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d."regionId" AND r.shop_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d."shopId"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_record(part_id,model_id,price_type,scope,region_id,shop_id,created_by) SELECT DISTINCT d."partId",d."modelId",d."priceType",d."scope",d."regionId",d."shopId",#{actor} FROM () d ON CONFLICT(part_id,model_id,price_type,scope,region_id,shop_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON(v.record_id) v.*,r.part_id,r.model_id,r.price_type,r.scope,r.region_id,r.shop_id FROM () d JOIN price_record r ON JOIN price_version v ON v.record_id=r.id ORDER BY v.record_id,v.version_no DESC

WITH drafts AS MATERIALIZED (), identities AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.*,r.id AS record_id FROM drafts d JOIN price_record r ON ), latest AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT ON(v.record_id) v.* FROM price_version v WHERE v.record_id IN(SELECT record_id FROM identities) ORDER BY v.record_id,v.version_no DESC), plan AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.*,nextval(pg_get_serial_sequence('price_version','id')) AS new_id, (coalesce(l.version_no,0)+row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY d.record_id ORDER BY d."effectiveFrom",d."rowNumber"))::integer AS new_no, l.id AS base_previous FROM identities d LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.record_id=d.record_id), linked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT p.*,coalesce(lag(new_id) OVER w,base_previous) AS previous_id, lead(new_id) OVER w AS next_id,lead("effectiveFrom") OVER w AS next_from FROM plan p WINDOW w AS(PARTITION BY record_id ORDER BY new_no)), close_old AS(UPDATE price_version v SET effective_to=n."effectiveFrom"-1,closed_by_version_id=n.new_id FROM linked n WHERE v.id=n.base_previous AND n.previous_id=n.base_previous AND v.effective_to IS NULL RETURNING v.id,v.effective_to,v.closed_by_version_id), closure_audit AS(INSERT INTO audit_log(actor_id,actor_roles,action,object_type,object_id,summary,trace_id) SELECT #{actor},#{roles},'PRICE_VERSION_CLOSE','PRICE_VERSION',id::text,'Closed at '||effective_to||'; successor ID '||closed_by_version_id,#{trace} FROM close_old RETURNING id), inserted AS(INSERT INTO price_version(id,record_id,version_no,amount,source_id,source_code,source_name,source_kind,effective_from,effective_to,previous_version_id,closed_by_version_id,batch_id,created_by) SELECT n.new_id,n.record_id,n.new_no,n."amount",s.id,s.code,s.name,s.kind,n."effectiveFrom", CASE WHEN n."effectiveTo" IS NULL AND n.next_id IS NOT NULL THEN n.next_from-1 ELSE n."effectiveTo" END, n.previous_id,CASE WHEN n."effectiveTo" IS NULL THEN n.next_id END,#{batchId},#{actor} FROM linked n JOIN price_source s ON s.id=n."sourceId" CROSS JOIN(SELECT count(*) FROM close_old) dependency ORDER BY n.record_id,n.new_no RETURNING *), new_closure_audit AS(INSERT INTO audit_log(actor_id,actor_roles,action,object_type,object_id,summary,trace_id) SELECT #{actor},#{roles},'PRICE_VERSION_CLOSE','PRICE_VERSION',n.new_id::text,'Closed at '||(n.next_from-1)||'; successor ID '||n.next_id,#{trace} FROM linked n JOIN inserted v ON v.id=n.new_id WHERE n."effectiveTo" IS NULL AND n.next_id IS NOT NULL RETURNING id) SELECT * FROM inserted ORDER BY record_id,version_no

SELECT d."rowNumber" AS row_number,p.id AS part_id,m.id AS model_id,b.id AS brand_id,p.name AS part_name,rg.id AS region_id,sh.id AS shop_id,s.id AS source_id,s.enabled AS source_enabled, (coalesce(d.alias,'')='' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM price_alias a WHERE a.part_id=p.id AND a.name=d.alias)) AS alias_valid, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM price_part_model pm WHERE pm.part_id=p.id AND pm.model_id=m.id) AS part_model_valid FROM jsonb_to_recordset(CAST(#{rows} AS jsonb)) AS d("rowNumber" integer,"brandCode" varchar,"modelCode" varchar,"internalCode" varchar,alias varchar,"regionCode" varchar,"shopCode" varchar,"sourceCode" varchar) LEFT JOIN price_brand b ON b.code=d."brandCode" LEFT JOIN price_model m ON m.brand_id=b.id AND m.code=d."modelCode" LEFT JOIN price_part p ON p.internal_code=d."internalCode" LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.code=d."regionCode" LEFT JOIN repair_shop sh ON sh.code=d."shopCode" LEFT JOIN price_source s ON s.code=d."sourceCode" ORDER BY d."rowNumber"
